Guideline 1 – Outsourcing of critical or important functions
1.1. The undertaking should establish a written outsourcing policy that is approved by the administrative, management or supervisory body.
1.2. Before outsourcing a critical or important function, the undertaking should perform a documented due diligence on the service provider.
1.3. The written agreement should grant the undertaking and its supervisory authority effective access to all data and premises of the service provider that relate to the outsourced function.
1.4. The undertaking should maintain an exit plan for each critical outsourcing arrangement and test it at least every two years.
2:
Guideline 2 – Data quality
2.1. The undertaking should assess the data used in the calculation of technical provisions against the criteria of accuracy, completeness and appropriateness.
2.2. The undertaking should document data deficiencies together with their impact and the remediation that is planned.
2.3. The undertaking should have the data quality framework reviewed by an independent party at least every three years.
